policy.status: Alternative-history planning forecast, not observed market data or negotiated price schedule
policy.geography: Worldwide microcomputer unit shipments; Logix includes UK distributor shipments. Five clone brands counted only for their compatible product lines. Other legacy products of those brands remain in other manufacturers.
demand_basis: 1981 unchanged until Team launch; 3% Q4 incremental intent reflects the adoption-price programme, bounded by support capacity.
1982 ramps reflect colour/mouse availability, native applications and local channel reach; no blanket multiplier is applied for signing clone contracts.
1983 factors apply to original same-quarter 1982 Logix demand, not compounded monthly growth; rising IBM/DOS competition is reflected by a modest growth path.
Deduct 35% of US clone shipments and 10% of continental clone shipments from gross Logix demand; these are explicit cannibalisation assumptions.
UK distribution is a subset of Logix units, never a seventh manufacturer. CAD hosts replace ordinary PRO purchases inside computer totals.

capacity.basis: Resource planning allowance, not a newly qualified fab/tool plan. Existing 3um costs retained, no unqualified process savings. Clone chip demand included on AION-supplied fraction; SGS owns its general fab infrastructure.

market.definition: Complete microcomputers, including home/business models; exclude peripherals, terminals, upgrades and software. Shipment-unit share, not revenue or installed-base share.
market.basis: 1981/1982 contemporaneous Dataquest estimates reported by TIME; scope comparability is approximate. 1983 round planning assumption, not a sourced historical count. Quarterly allocation 21/23/25/31 is modelled, not observed. Add only 20% of Logix+clone demand to the calibrated market; the remainder displaces other suppliers.

financial_policy.scope: Logix computer task bundles only. Additional paid offers and clone supply/royalties are separate streams in ROI. Autodesk licence receipts excluded from project revenue.
financial_policy.retail_spend: Quantity × dated retail_price_usd for every weighted basket offer.
financial_policy.after_channel_fees: Quantity × dated revenue_after_fee_usd, already net of the modeled fee.
financial_policy.recurring_cost: Quantity × dated manufacturing_cost_usd; includes the recurring contents and services defined in retail pricing.
financial_policy.contribution: After channel fees minus recurring cost, before corporate development, marketing, capital/depreciation and tax.
financial_policy.timing: Use dated June/December catalogue assessments; June snapshots proxy whole June, COMDEX CAD shipments begin December 1982. 1983 holds December 1982 unit prices/costs; new Office Professional and Business Accounts priced contents replace legacy variants. Pending installation/backup scope is not claimed as a firm quote; support/qualification allowances remain explicit. No speculative process savings.
financial_policy.rounding: Round each weighted offer line to cents, then sum lines, months, quarters and years. Contribution is net receipts minus recurring cost in integer cents.
financial_policy.demand: 1981–83 reassessment; clone cannibalisation and CAD substitution explicit.
